events.text:
- Q press handling (change request): if the call bar is not full, the hint line shows "CALL NOT READY" for 60 frames (hint priority 8) with a `beep`. If it is full and the captain is not free, the press is kept for up to 600 frames and the call starts on the first frame the captain is free (`call.gd` `queued_f`, public, read by `mod.gd`). The hint says "CALL: STAND UP FIRST" when the captain is in KNOCKDOWN, GETUP or WALLSPLAT, otherwise "CALL WHEN UP". The kept press is dropped if the bar is no longer full, the captain falls, or a call is already running.
- While a press is kept, the call label reads "READY  CALL WHEN UP". The Q key stays lit because core's show.gd lights it whenever the label contains "READY".
- New block in `data/rally.json`: `press` = {say_f 60, hint_p 8, beep_db -6, queue_max_f 600, and the three hint texts}. No existing values changed.
- NOT DONE: showing "CALL WHEN UP" on the Q key itself needs scripts/show.gd, which is outside my scope. The exact edit: at line 84, replace the Q key's fixed sub-label `"CALL"` with `("CALL WHEN UP" if "WHEN UP" in str(g.hud.text_of(&"call")) else "CALL")`.
- No bot test presses Q while the captain is down, so the kept press is not checked by any run. A person should try it by hand.
